dog.description_text: Hi, I'm Hall, a 2-month-old black domestic shorthair with a striking van pattern and 3.5 lbs of pure charm! 🐾 I'm already neutered and ready to start my life with my forever family. People describe me as affectionate, energetic, friendly, gentle, loyal, and playful, and I can't wait to show you every bit of it! 💛 Come meet me at the shelter and see if we're a perfect match! 🏡
dog.name: Hall
